preconditions.description: Number of planets is between 1 and 100,000.
Number of Hyperspace™ highways is between 1 and 500,000.
Number of queries is between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i < v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in highways)
preconditions.description: Each highway connects two different planets within the range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_j < b_j <= N for a_j, b_j in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies two different planets within the range.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(distance, int) and distance >= 0 for distance in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of Hyperspace™ highways needed.
